result.brief: 提出分层智能体框架 DramaAgent，通过故事规划、角色状态保持与反思式修复，实现长时序文本到视频与音频的连贯生成。
result.reason: Agentic hierarchical framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation with character consistency and cross-modal audio-visual alignment; directly targets long video generation and joint audiovisual coherence.
